content: Alagepa vayaꞌe Gotifeꞌmo mono nosaya vayaꞌefeꞌmo apava ge yokemae

Gotifeꞌmo mono nosaya vayaꞌmogimo apakesamo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo, ina kateꞌmo viyo, huꞌa nehaya kateꞌmo umenitata osuge hosu kavaꞌmo nehaya vayaꞌmo neꞌvaya kateꞌmo uꞌa he tiꞌa oꞌmaige mono katefeꞌmo, afa kane, huꞌa huteꞌa huꞌa faipa huꞌa neꞌataya vayaꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌa itopaleꞌmo oꞌmaige huꞌa neꞌmaiya vayaꞌmogimo Goti aulagaleꞌmo alagepa huꞌa maiꞌnayanageꞌa afaꞌa apamogaga aigae.
Ani agufa kavaꞌmo nosayaꞌmonanafa Ala kava neꞌmo keꞌaepa geꞌalefekeꞌmo amuse huteꞌa apamogaga neꞌaiye. Apakaemo felugaꞌe haniꞌilagaꞌeꞌmo keꞌaepa geꞌaekeꞌmo apakesa afifi huꞌa neꞌmaiye.

Apakaemo ani agoꞌnanena folagapiꞌmo fai maleꞌniya yosamoꞌmo alagamo neꞌaeya afinaꞌmo alagamo neꞌaesigenoꞌaeꞌmo haitaꞌamo falu noteya yosagana huꞌa maiꞌnae. Muki aliꞌnaya aliꞌyaꞌapimoꞌmo alagepa huno afole neꞌaiye.
Hosu vayaꞌmo ani kava huꞌa oꞌmaiꞌnae. Apakaemo mago haletiꞌya yakana huꞌa maiꞌnae. Haleti yaꞌamo haleꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo yasimoꞌmo alino halelino neꞌviya haletiꞌya yakana huꞌa maiꞌnae.

Maiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo Gotifeꞌmo mono nosaya vayaꞌmo agoti huno apatesiya yateꞌmo he tiꞌa oꞌmaiꞌa alagi asagauꞌa aigae. Inagi hosu kavaꞌmo nehaya vayaꞌmogimo fatago vayaꞌmo aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maisayapiꞌmo uꞌa oꞌmaigae.
Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa fatago vayaꞌmogimo nehaya kavaꞌapieꞌmo apakeno amuse huno neꞌapateyaꞌmonanafa agaefeꞌmo mono nosaya vayaꞌai aliꞌyaꞌapimo alino hano huno atalesigeꞌa alagi lageso hugae.
